tagline: Beautiful BIAB, acrylic and gel nails, booked in a few taps
about: Every appointment is one-to-one, so you get my full attention and a relaxed, friendly visit. Pick your treatment below, choose a time that suits you and you're all booked in.

announcement.title: Happy Halloween
announcement.text: Spooky season is here... Get your nails ready for all the Halloween plans with boo-tiful nails to match!

policies: Want nail art, a gel overlay or repairs? Just add it in the notes when you book.
Please give at least 24 hours' notice if you need to cancel or move your appointment.
Running more than 15 minutes late may mean a shorter treatment or rebooking.
